scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server --include=dev && npm run build --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:seo
scripts.test:seo: npm run build --prefix server && node --test server/test/seo.test.cjs
